ratings_why.fun: Over a 7 because every fish's slot is a turn-by-turn choice between two payoff engines, and the cards cross over: Big Tam is a hoarder and a spawner, the Grandfather cashes a hoard through a homecoming, and Bradán hatches every Fry at once.
ratings_why.distinct: Front row as the road home and gifts to neighbours feel new; the Spawn repeaters are a familiar Brann/Rivendare shape in fish clothing.

verdict_why: The engine is in a good spot, but two timing rules can't be read yet: Stamps gained during a fight, and Mother Redd's Spawn when Bradán triggers it.

points.text: Claw-Marked Cock and Seal-Scarred Veteran give Stamps during the fight, but base Stamps arrive at Start of Turn. Say when theirs land, whether a unit that dies keeps them, and whether Captain Kype's Attack rises mid-fight.
When Old Bradán triggers Mother Redd's Spawn, does she lose her Stamps, and does it count toward 'the first two times'? Her spare-me clause sits inside the Spawn text, so it reads both ways.
Little Jack Gravel sits next to the redd, so he catches the spent fish's gift and grows out of the Bailiff's reach. That's a lovely hidden line; a build note naming Jack as a carry would show it off.
A passported unit has no Spawn, so Bradán and Jack do nothing for it. Letting its When-played count as its Spawn would make the Passport Seller the tribe's wildest cross-tribe toy.
The Bailiff eating a Fry destroys it without spending it, so its fresh copy is lost and Kelt and the Grandfather don't fire. Good tension; keep it, and show it on the card's tooltip.

standouts.why: Old Bradán fires every Spawn, hatches every Fry and can restart the homecoming chain through the Parr's Stamps.
Big Tam pays for hoarding and for going home, so where you park him is a real decision every turn.
The Grandfather joins the two builds: hoard Stamps for turns, then send one fish home for a board-wide cash-out.

weakest.why: Pilgrim Guide is plain gold on a homecoming; it only gets interesting under Jack and Bradán.
Fish-Pass Keeper is a static number change that works against every hoard card.
Reunion Secretary asks you to count matching Stamps across the board for a small buff.

flags.note: Old Kelt's copy plus the Fry's copy makes a triple roughly every two homecomings, and on passported units it triples other tribes' cards.
The Salmon of Llyn Llyw scales with a Stamp total that never drops in a hoard, applied to every other unit, so late fights can swing very large.
When a passported or golden unit lays a Fry, is the fresh copy golden, and does it keep its passport?
